Package com.hiface.sdk

Class HiFaceSdk

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.HiFaceSdk
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.lang.AutoCloseable
public final class HiFaceSdk extends java.lang.Object implements java.lang.AutoCloseable
Root object of the Android HiFace SDK.

Provides configuration, live frame input, and a single close operation. Capture, liveness, 1:1 verification, and continuous search are exposed through four capability objects. HiFaceSdk.Builder.build() starts SDK initialization in the background. The SDK does not manage the camera.

  • Method Details

    • builder

      @NonNull public static HiFaceSdk.Builder builder(@NonNull android.content.Context context)
      Create an SDK builder. It retains only the Application Context.

    • openSearchDatabase

      @WorkerThread @NonNull public static HiFaceResult<FaceSearchDatabase> openSearchDatabase(@NonNull android.content.Context context)
      Open this application's face library. The SDK manages the location in application-private storage. No HiFaceSdk instance or model initialization is required; only the Application Context is retained. Each call returns an independent connection to the same data. Run database operations on a worker thread and close each connection separately. Use for enrollment, management, or direct feature queries. Continuous camera search opens its own connection automatically.

    • processFrame

      @NonNull public HiFaceResult<FaceDetectionResult> processFrame(@NonNull Yuv420Frame frame)
      Process one host-provided YUV_420_888 frame synchronously. Input Buffers are not retained after return. Submit frames serially and keep only the newest frame when processing cannot keep up. Camera analysis supports landscape or portrait 1080p; exceeding Yuv420Frame.MAX_LONG_SIDE_PIXELS by Yuv420Frame.MAX_SHORT_SIDE_PIXELS returns INVALID_ARGUMENT. Frames arriving before initialization are discarded promptly. A skipped frame returns NOT_READY; release it and continue with newer frames instead of waiting or retrying the old frame.

    • processFrame

      @NonNull public HiFaceResult<FaceDetectionResult> processFrame(@NonNull Yuv420Frame frame, @NonNull FaceDetectionConfig config)
      Process a frame with the requested detection settings. config controls only the number and detail of public detection results. Active capture, liveness, or verification flows request required landmarks and multiple-face checks automatically; the host need not increase FaceDetectionConfig.getMaxFaces(). The first request for detailed landmarks may prepare a model in the background and return NOT_READY until later frames are ready. Uses the same idle-throttling rules as the unconfigured overload. Active camera flows and Bitmap image operations are not idle-throttled. During camera search, its session settings determine face selection; this method returns selected boxes and five landmarks without ordinary detection mesh/pose output. Read search scores and identities from the search listener.

    • search

      @NonNull public FaceSearchApi search()

    • processFrame

      @NonNull public HiFaceResult<FaceDetectionResult> processFrame(@NonNull RgbIrFrame frame)
      Submit a paired RGB and IR frame synchronously, after starting single-face search with infraredLiveness configured. Pixels are borrowed until return. Identity and IR decisions are delivered asynchronously to the search listener; this return value contains only RGB detection. Preparation, pause, or backpressure returns NOT_READY. Without an active search, this entry does not fall back to ordinary RGB detection.

    • close

      @MainThread public void close()
      Close all image, capture, liveness, and verification requests, search sessions and their connections, worker threads, and the SDK. May be called repeatedly. Independently opened face libraries must still be closed by the caller. Page-scoped instances bound through HiFaceSdk.Builder.lifecycleOwner(androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner) normally do not need a manual close.
